git.head_subject: Round S3: replicate the noise crossover on an independent seed, to b = 16

absent_dependency_consequences: no jsonschema -> the strict manifest validator is implemented in-repo with its own tests
no hypothesis -> property-based tests are hand-rolled with explicit seeds, and are NOT a substitute for a shrinking fuzzer
no psutil -> memory accounting uses stdlib tracemalloc and resource.getrusage
no matplotlib -> artifacts/s4_g100/plots stays empty; summaries are CSV/JSON text so nothing binary enters version control

toolchain_absent.lean: no lean, lake or elan on PATH; no formal/ directory existed
toolchain_absent.consequence: P1-P5 are written as exact Lean 4 source plus theorem obligations and are NOT claimed to compile

baseline_tests.note: 128/128 pass; no baseline failures to isolate

governing_negative_results_carried_forwa: RET-S3-HYPERCOMPLEX_DIAGNOSIS: hypercomplex coordinates tie, they do not improve
RET-S3-OCTONIONIC_SHEAF: flatness fails above the quaternionic regime; no octonionic flat sheaf may be reintroduced
RET-R3-SCALAR_PROMOTION: promotion is a region, never a weighted scalar
RET-S1-TRANSCENDENCE_SENTINEL, RET-S2-STOKES_ROUTER_ACCURACY: killed on their own conditions
no coordinate has been shown to improve general cognitive performance
